canonical_example.text: Hay algunas colonias en donde viven más alienígenas.
canonical_example.translation: There are some neighborhoods where more foreigners live.

canonical_example.translation: I definitely believe in extraterrestrial life.

canonical_example.translation: I love comparative literature because you find links between works otherwise unrelated.

canonical_example.translation: You cannot compare Floyd Mayweather to Mike Tyson. They have different styles.

canonical_example.translation: The quality just doesn't compare with our preferred brand of coffee.

canonical_example.translation: I've made a comparison, but they still look the same to me.

canonical_example.translation: You think you are a loser because you always compare yourself to others who are doing better.

canonical_example.text: Puedes usar mi teléfono viejo si no logras encontrar el tuyo.
canonical_example.translation: You can use my old phone if you don't manage to find yours.

canonical_example.translation: In summer, dresses and skirts are worn again.

canonical_example.translation: You have erred in your decision, and you will pay dearly your mistake.

canonical_example.translation: I gave her another chance and she failed me again.

canonical_example.translation: I know I let you down, professor. - You didn't let me down, Beto; you let yourself down.

canonical_example.translation: The column gave way and the building collapsed.

canonical_example.translation: If we keep losing sales, we risk going bankrupt.

canonical_example.translation: Our food has run out. One of us will have to go down to the town to get something to eat.

canonical_example.text: Como parte del trato con el banco, la empresa recibió una quita de la deuda.
canonical_example.translation: As part of the deal with the bank, the company received a release from the debt.

canonical_example.text: El rifle M1 Garand es un calibre .30.
canonical_example.translation: The M1 Garand rifle has a .30 caliber.

canonical_example.translation: According to the expert witness, the victim was shot with a .22 calibre pistol.

canonical_example.translation: These bullets are the wrong gage. The Colt revolver is a .45.

canonical_example.translation: Pipes of a small caliber tend to get blocked up.

canonical_example.translation: I measured the calibre of the pipe with a measuring tape.

canonical_example.translation: Buy wire netting of a thick gage.

canonical_example.translation: "We need a cylinder of a greater bore," said the plummer.

canonical_example.translation: Never has a singer of the calibre of Pavarotti sung in this opera house.

canonical_example.text: Es vergonzoso que una actriz de su calibre jamás haya ganado un Óscar.
canonical_example.translation: It's shameful that an actress of her class has never won an Oscar.

canonical_example.translation: The gunsmith calibrated the old rifle and told us it's a .38 caliber gun.

canonical_example.translation: This tool will help you gauge different types of wire.

canonical_example.translation: Dario measured all the screws to find the ones with the diameter he needs.

canonical_example.translation: We need to calibrate the scale because the weight it's showing is off.

canonical_example.translation: The practice game allowed the team to gauge its possibilities of winning the tournament.

canonical_example.text: Te sugiero que calibres bien las posibles consecuencias de esa decisión.
canonical_example.translation: I'd suggest you weigh up all the possible consequences of that decision.

canonical_example.text: Levanta la mano si quieres ir al parque.
canonical_example.translation: Raise your hand if you want to go to the park.

canonical_example.translation: He is unable to lift the suitcase.

canonical_example.translation: What time did you get up today?

canonical_example.translation: Can you help me lift up the sofa?

canonical_example.translation: He bent over to pick up the chair off the floor.

canonical_example.translation: Get up, the floor is not clean.

canonical_example.translation: Cain rose up against Abel and killed him.

canonical_example.translation: His body was burned and his skin came off when touched.

canonical_example.text: Cuando el miembro de la oposición acusó al ministro de malversación, se armó una polvareda.
canonical_example.translation: When the opposition member accused the minister of embezzlement, mayhem broke out.
